visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a grey flat cap and a green sweatshirt stands in front of a projector screen in a modern cafe setting. He gestures with his hands while addressing a small group of seated people, including a woman with bright pink hair in the foreground. (2) The scene cuts between the speaker and the audience; a woman in a white t-shirt stands near a wooden slated wall, and various audience members are seen holding up smartphones to record the event. The environment features warm lighting and green tea themed posters on the wall. (3) Close-up shots show individuals using bamboo whisks (chasen) to vigorously stir bright green matcha powder in black ceramic bowls. Trays on the tables hold multiple bowls and paper cups. (4) The speaker walks around the room, handing out small square packets to the participants. He smiles and interacts directly with a woman and a young child seated at a table. (5) Back at the front of the room, the man wears a large orange cross-body bag and holds up a pink garment, presumably a t-shirt, while continuing his presentation. The audience is seen clapping and smiling. (6) He hands a black cap to a woman in a striped sweater; they share a friendly exchange. The camera captures her reaction as she inspects the cap. (7) The final shot is a wide group portrait of about ten people standing in the cafe, everyone holding up their matcha drinks and smiling at the camera in a celebratory pose.
